en_US: Mr. Fuego: Well, hello!
It’s not often I get a visitor here.
I tried to make the ironworks run
better with the moving floor tiles.
But no one was happy about it! They
said the moving floor made them dizzy!
But you don’t want to listen to me
whine. Here’s a souvenir!
Mr. Fuego: My ironworks makes iron by
removing impurities from iron ore.
In the process, we find a variety of
colored Shards.
If you’d like, we can trade Star Pieces
for these Shards.
Mr. Fuego: My ironworks makes iron by
removing impurities from iron ore.
In the process, we find a variety of
colored Shards.
If you’d like, we can trade Star Pieces
for these Shards?
Mr. Fuego: Do you have any Star Pieces?
You can trade them for various Shards.
Mr. Fuego: Are you interested?
Want to trade Star Pieces for Shards?
Mr. Fuego: I see you’ve got many Star
Pieces.
Would you like to trade ten of them?
Mr. Fuego: There you are--
red, blue, yellow, and green.
Shards in different colors!
Mr. Fuego: My ironworks would be
nothing if there were no iron.
That’s why I’m always thankful for
nature supplying me with iron.
Thorton: Bzweeeeep!
I’m Thorton, the Factory Head.
I came here to see how Trainers hold
up after a ride on the moving floor.
Beat me, and you can pick one of my
Battle Factory rentals to keep.
So, want to battle?
Thorton: No? My rentals will wait.
Come back when you’re ready.
Thorton: Hmm...
I got handed the loss here.
A deal’s a deal, though.
Thorton: So, did you get to like your
rental Pokémon?
As the Factory Head, it would sure
make me happy if you did.
